WEBSITE INFORMATION

Privacy notice

How this website handles your information. Effective 11 October 2026.

Website operator

Guangzhou PanPanTech Co., Ltd. operates PanPan Marine. For enquiries about this website or information you send us, contact panda@panpantechnology.com.

Project-brief form

The brief form processes the information you enter in your browser. Preparing and downloading a brief does not send it to a sales team. The site does not store your form contents in browser storage or an inquiry database.

The email-draft action opens your mail application with the brief. You decide whether to send it. Your email provider and the recipient’s privacy terms apply to that transmission.

Hosting, analytics and external services

The hosting service may process connection information needed to deliver and secure the website. External links lead to services with their own privacy practices.

No marketing analytics, advertising pixels or optional tracking cookies have been added by this site.

Downloads

Downloaded briefs remain on your device. Delete them when no longer needed and avoid including confidential information in an initial inquiry.

Business contact and review

Business enquiries you send us are used to review your request and correspond with you. Contact us using the email above with questions about information you have provided. The quotation identifies the legal seller and agreed commercial responsibilities.
